questions.stem: The diagram shows an atom of an element.

This question is about carboxylic acids. Solutions of carboxylic acids react with magnesium metal to form hydrogen gas. This is the student's method. pour some carboxylic acid solution into a conical flask add some magnesium powder quickly connect the gas syringe and start a timer record the time taken to collect $ 1 0 \mathrm{c m}^{3} $ of hydrogen gas The student repeats the method with three other carboxylic acids. A student uses this apparatus to investigate the time taken to produce $ 1 0 \mathrm{c m}^{3} $ of hydrogen gas from different carboxylic acids.
This question is about sodium and potassium. A trough is filled with water and a few drops of phenolphthalein indicator are added.
This question is about the metal aluminium.
This question is about the insoluble salt silver chloride (AgCl). Silver chloride can be made by the reaction between copper(II) chloride and silver nitrate.
This question is about octane $ \left( \mathrm{C}_{8} \mathrm{H}_{1 8} \right) $ which is produced in the gasoline fraction during fractional distillation of crude oil.

entries.answerText:

D is the correct answer because protons occur in the nucleus and have a positive charge.
A is not the correct answer since electrons occur in the energy levels.
B is not the answer since ions do not occur in the nucleus.
C is not the correct answer since neutrons have no charge.
